style_findings.finding: Missing consistent error handling for OIDC callback in auth service
style_findings.description: The OIDC callback handler does not include comprehensive error logging or user-friendly error messages for failed authentication attempts.

style_findings.finding: Inconsistent use of environment variables for OIDC configuration
style_findings.description: Some OIDC settings are hardcoded while others are pulled from environment variables, leading to potential misconfigurations in different deployment environments.

style_findings.finding: Lack of input validation for redirect URI in auth service
style_findings.description: The redirect URI is not validated against a whitelist, which could lead to open redirect vulnerabilities.
